skill.name: eew-monitor
skill.description: 緊急地震速報(EEW)の発表状況と直近の地震・津波情報を、キー不要の公開APIから取得する。緊急地震速報、EEW、強震モニタ、今地震あった?に対応。気象庁の確定した発表(震度詳細・警報)はbosai-alert、天気予報はjma-weatherを使う。
skill.summary: Check Japanese earthquake early warning status and recent earthquake or tsunami bulletins through public, unofficial API relays.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: All 35 static findings are false positives: Markdown backticks, public HTTPS endpoints, a documentation link, and readable multilingual text explain the detections. No evidence found of prompt injection, secret collection, destructive operations, or concealed executable content. The skill explicitly warns about unofficial feeds, stale bulletins, and failures, and directs emergency decisions to official announcements.

static_findings.snippet: > **情報源の性質**: ここで使うAPI(P2P地震情報、wolfx)はどちらも**気象庁の電文を中継するコミュニティ運営の非公式サービス**。速報性は高いが、気象庁の公式サイトではない。確定情報
```bash
- `Title`: 「緊急地震速報(予報)」または「緊急地震速報(警報)」
- `Issue.Status`: `通常` はそのEEWが終了(最終報)した状態。`isFinal: true` と対応する
- `EventID`: 発生時刻ベースのID (例 `20260913053312`)
- `OriginTime`: 発生時刻 / `Hypocenter`: 震源 / `Latitude`,`Longitude`,`Depth`(km)
- `Magnitude`: マグニチュード(ペイロードには誤記の `Magunitude` も同居するが `Magnitude` を使う)
- `MaxIntensity`: 最大予測震度 (例 `"2"`)
- `isWarn`: `true` なら警報(最大震度5弱以上の予測)、`false` なら予報
- `isCancel`: キャンセル報なら `true`
- `WarnArea`: 警報対象地域名の配列(予報では空)
- `AnnouncedTime` / `Serial`: 発表時刻と報数(第何報か)
**終了後も直近の電文が残る**: EEWが出ていない平時でも、最後に発表されたEEWの最終報が返る(2026-09-13に05:32発生の奄美大島北東沖M5.1の最終報を実測)。「いま発表中か」は
```bash
すべて2026-09-13実測。`codes=551` は地震情報、`552` は津波予報。主なフィールド:
- `earthquake.time` / `hypocenter.name,magnitude,depth,latitude,longitude`: 発生時刻と震源
- `earthquake.maxScale`: 最大震度。`震度×10` の数値(例 `20`=震度2、2026-09-13実測)。仕様上 `45`=5弱、`50`=5強、`55`=6弱、`60`=
- `earthquake.domesticTsunami`: `None`(津波のおそれなし)など
- `points[]`: 観測点ごとの `addr`(地点名)、`pref`(都道府県)、`scale`
- `issue.type`: `DetailScale`(震源・震度詳細)などの情報種別
履歴は最大100件程度しか遡れない。期間指定の検索や確定情報の網羅的な一覧は気象庁側(`bosai-alert`)で行う。
- 引用時は発表時刻(`OriginTime`/`issue.time`)を必ず併記する。
- **タイムアウトを付ける**: `curl -sm 30` のように必ず制限時間を付ける。
- **`[]` や古い最終報はエラーではない**: P2Pの履歴で `[]` が返る場合は対象コードの情報が期間内にない正常な結果。wolfxで古い最終報が返るのは平時の正常な状態。
- **フィールド欠損**: 第1報などでは `MaxIntensity` や `WarnArea` が空のことがある。欠損を0や「被害なし」と読み替えず、「まだ入っていない項目」として伝える。
curl -s https://api.wolfx.jp/jma_eew.json
curl -s "https://api.p2pquake.net/v2/history?codes=551&limit=5"
curl -s "https://api.p2pquake.net/v2/jma/quake?limit=1"
curl -s "https://api.p2pquake.net/v2/jma/tsunami?limit=1"
強震モニタ(約700観測点のリアルタイム震度)は、気象庁の公式ページ https://www.kyoshin.bosai.go.jp/ でブラウザから見るのが確実。観測点ごとの数値をcurlで安定取得
- **HTTP 5xx / タイムアウト**: 非公式サービス側の障害の可能性。1〜2回だけ再試行し、直らなければ「速報系APIが応答していません」と明示したうえで、気象庁の防災情報ページ http
共通の取得時チェックリストは [共通レスポンス契約](../docs/response-contract.md) の「取得時の落とし穴チェックリスト」を参照。

content.user_title: Check Japan Earthquake and Tsunami Bulletins
content.value_statement: Recent earthquake bulletins can be difficult to interpret, especially when old warnings remain visible. This skill retrieves public Japanese earthquake and tsunami reports and explains timestamps, warning status, and missing data.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the latest Japanese earthquake early warning bulletin from the keyless wolfx API.
Explain warning, cancellation, final-report, and timestamp fields to distinguish current bulletins from stale reports.
Retrieve recent earthquake history and the latest earthquake bulletin through P2P Quake API v2.
Retrieve the latest tsunami bulletin and explain available tsunami status fields.
Interpret Japanese seismic intensity codes and observation locations in earthquake reports.
Explain missing fields, empty history, and API failures while directing users to official announcements.
limitations: Community-operated relays are unofficial and can delay or omit reports; they must not replace official emergency announcements.
The skill documents on-demand requests, not continuous monitoring, push notifications, or guaranteed warning delivery.
History covers approximately 100 records, without comprehensive archives; automated Strong Motion Monitor observation retrieval is unsupported.
Network access and curl are required; the referenced shared response checklist and sibling skills are not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Check Reports After Feeling Shaking
use_cases.description: Retrieve recent Japanese earthquake reports and distinguish a current warning from an old final bulletin.
use_cases.target_user: Residents in Japan seeking supplementary earthquake information

use_cases.title: Prepare a Timestamped News Brief
use_cases.description: Summarize reported epicenter, magnitude, intensity, and tsunami information while identifying unofficial sources and confirming details through official announcements.

use_cases.title: Review Public Bulletin Fields
use_cases.description: Inspect recent earthquake and tsunami bulletins and understand status flags, intensity codes, and missing values.
use_cases.target_user: Developers evaluating public seismic data feeds

prompt_templates.title: Check the Latest Warning
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Japan's latest earthquake early warning. Include its timestamp and explain whether it is current, final, or cancelled.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: request a concise warning-status summary

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Recent Earthquakes
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the five latest Japanese earthquake bulletins with event times, epicenters, magnitudes, and maximum intensities. Identify unavailable fields and the source.

prompt_templates.title: Review Tsunami Information
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the latest tsunami bulletin and latest earthquake report. Include timestamps and source limitations, and direct emergency decisions to official announcements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review related earthquake and tsunami information

prompt_templates.title: Assess Bulletin Freshness
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the latest EEW with recent earthquake bulletins using timestamps, final and cancellation flags, and available status fields. Use timeouts and limited retries. Separate stale records, missing fields, and retrieval failures, and include official verification links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: assess freshness and retrieval reliability

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative summary when the latest EEW is an old final report.
output: Illustrative result: The latest returned EEW is a completed bulletin, not evidence of a current warning.
The recorded event occurred at 05:32 on September 13, 2026, northeast of Amami Oshima, with magnitude 5.1.
Source: wolfx, an unofficial relay of JMA bulletins.
This historical example is not a live status check. Follow official JMA and local-government announcements for emergency decisions.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative response when the bulletin API remains unavailable after limited retries.
output: Illustrative result: The bulletin API did not respond after limited retries.
Current warning status could not be verified. A retrieval failure does not mean there is no warning.
Check the JMA disaster information page and official local announcements directly.

best_practices: Include event and publication timestamps when available, and identify each community relay as unofficial.
Use request timeouts, retry only once or twice, and avoid rapid repeated requests.
Preserve uncertainty around stale reports and missing fields; verify emergency information through official JMA and local-government announcements.
anti_patterns: Treating an unavailable API, empty history, or missing intensity field as proof of safety.
Presenting an old final bulletin as a currently active earthquake early warning.
Using community feeds as the sole emergency authority or polling them at high frequency.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The documented wolfx and P2P Quake endpoints provide public data without API keys or login.

faq.question: Are these official JMA APIs?
faq.answer: No. They are community-operated relays of JMA bulletins. Verify confirmed information through JMA and local-government announcements.

faq.question: Why does the API return an old warning?
faq.answer: The wolfx endpoint retains the latest EEW after it ends. Check timestamps and final status before describing a warning as current.

faq.question: Does this skill provide continuous alerts?
faq.answer: No. It documents on-demand checks, not background monitoring or push notifications. It does not guarantee warning delivery.

faq.question: Can it retrieve Strong Motion Monitor station values?
faq.answer: No. The skill directs users to the browser-based Strong Motion Monitor instead of retrieving station observations automatically.

faq.question: What happens when an API fails?
faq.answer: Use a timeout and one or two retries, then report the failure and provide official links. Never describe retrieval failure as no warning.
